title: Modular Data Processing Pipeline
description: Designed and built a distributed, fault-tolerant, and scalable production data processing solution capable of ingesting any tabular data structure to improved processing speeds by over 400%.
longDescription: Created a highly scalable and fault-tolerant data processing pipeline that handles large volumes of data from Qualcomm's Product and Test Engineering fabrication data. The solution was recognized as a Top 5 Innovation across Qualcomm globally in a 2021 business review, and resulted in processing speed improvements of over 400% compared to the previous system.
